At some point in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]], a '''business rival''' of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], leader of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization, gave the latter a tiny replica of the rare and magnificient [[firethorn tree]]s. An offer that Xizor considered as one of his most precious.
